title: Chapter 85: The Final Battle Of The Camps
content:
Chapter 85: The Final Battle Of The Camps

The Tengu Clan’s main camp, with square formations of 20,000, 10,000, 5,000, etc., continued to gather in the plain area in front of the two camps.

The Evil God Camp saw this and could only gather troops immediately to confront the Tengu Clan.

The camps of both sides were called large camps, but in fact they relied on a territory to expand the protection range of the lord. The scale of their cities was not large and could not be used as solid positions.

The main forces of both camps were deployed outside the city, which was easy to attack but difficult to defend. When one side gathered forces to launch an attack, the other side could not defend on the spot and could only gather forces to confront.

Originally, the difference in the forces of the two sides was not big, but this time the Zerg army commanded by Wu Qing turned the world upside down in the rear of the Evil God Camp and mobilized a large number of troops of the Evil God Camp that were originally in confrontation.

The forces assembled by the Tengu Clan soon exceeded 500,000, while the forces assembled by the opposite Evil God Camp were less than 300,000, which was a huge advantage in force.

With such a military advantage, the Tengu tribe did not waste it. They launched a full-scale attack on the formation of the evil god camp without even preparing large-scale projectile weapons!

The long-range shooting of hundreds of thousands of troops was amazing!

Spears, stones, chain hammers, axes and other throwing objects and arrows and crossbows fell like a rainstorm from the sky, smashing into the formations of both sides, like ripples on a calm lake.

The local soldiers of various races in the Tengu tribe camp who were charging in front, holding shields in their hands, rushed forward with all their strength. When they fell, the shields in their hands would be picked up by their compatriots in the back and continue to charge!

The evil god camp was unwilling to be outdone, and the front-line troops also launched a charge!

Like two huge waves, the two sides violently collided on the vast plain!

The close combat began the most tragic melee fight in the era of cold weapons!

Although the soldiers of the native races are not controlled by faith like the evil god believers and are not afraid of life and death, they also understand that as long as the war fails, they will live a life worse than death!

Therefore, in this world, even normal intelligent creatures look lightly on life and death.

In the deadly fights that are done to the extreme, countless lives are dying every moment, and the battlefield is bloody and dead bodies are everywhere in an instant!

Although the war here has a certain indirect causal relationship with Wu Qing, it may be that this causality is not enough for the system to come here to rob resources, and the corpses on the battlefield are left.

The real battlefield without the system cleaning is horrible!

Wu Qing looked at the war that he had provoked in advance, and there was no ripple in his heart.

This war between the two camps will be fought sooner or later. For those who are destined to participate in it, it is better to finish it early and get rid of it early.

Waves of soldiers rushed up to fight. There were not many tactics in this camp war. It was all about strength and consumption.

The strength advantage of the Tengu tribe soon showed its effect. With the continuous investment of troops, the battlefield opened up became larger and larger. The evil god camp was already a little overwhelmed, which made the Tengu tribe's army form a semi-siege against the evil god camp's army.

The increase in the scope of the battle made the troops of both sides consume faster.

Many priests of the evil god camp began to bless the army with faith, and the lords of the Tengu tribe also began to consume the luck in the luck beads and use secret methods to bless the army with various gains.

Various state blessings opened Wu Qing's eyes. The in-depth research of this world on faith energy and luck really made him look at it with new eyes.

With the blessing of the state, the combat power of both sides has increased greatly, which makes the fighting on the battlefield even more tragic.

The war has begun. The Tengu tribe has an initial advantage in strength. As the troops of the evil god camp continue to return to join the battlefield, this advantage will become smaller and smaller.

...

Wu Qing ordered the Zerg to start action and continue to harvest resources to contain as many troops of the evil god camp as possible for the Tengu tribe.

By the way, let the people of this world see what the Zerg Sea Tactics are!

The Zerg's battles one after another provided the system with enough resources, allowing the Zerg to have as many troops as they wanted. Every two minutes, more than 500 troops were deployed, enough to form a wave after wave of continuous offensives.

The cavalry units of the various tribes of the evil god camp were the ones chasing the Zerg army the most closely. After the Zerg's interception, the cavalry units still had about 20,000 troops.

The Zerg army continued to run with the cavalry units of the evil god camp for a distance, leaving the other evil god armies far behind.

At this time, the number of puppies assembled by the Zerg army exceeded 10,000, plus 3,000 hydralisks, which was enough for a battle!

The scouting puppies began to clear the various scouts and eyes around. With the anti-stealth vision provided by the host that had almost no presence in the air, no one could escape the eyes of the Zerg.

Some of the puppies went underground to lurk in advance. When the Zerg army and the pursuing evil god camp cavalry entered the area where the puppies were lurking, the hydralisks turned around and began to counterattack.

Three thousand Hydralisks fired at the cavalry troops charging at high speed. The cavalry troops of the evil god camp fell to the ground and disappeared in large numbers, but this did not stop their rapid charge.

The disappearance of the dead cavalry and mounts also created favorable conditions for the smooth charge of the cavalry of the evil god camp. The cavalry troops rushed to the front of the Hydralisks despite the consumption.

After a round of close shooting, the Hydralisks quickly retreated. Nearly 5,000 puppies on the ground rushed up and fought with the cavalry troops of the evil god camp.

Three thousand Hydralisks were divided into many teams, choosing favorable terrain around to provide support shooting and precise blocking.

Five thousand puppies opened the battle line and fought desperately with the cavalry of the evil god camp, and the troops of both sides were consumed very quickly.

When the number of Zerg puppies dropped to less than a thousand, the cavalry of the evil god camp felt that victory was in sight.

At this moment, a large number of Zerg puppies rushed out from the rear of the Zerg army again, which made the mood of the cavalry of the evil god camp instantly fall to the bottom.

With the participation of the Zerg puppies who came to reinforce, the battle between the two sides became fierce again.

But such a battle also bought time for the pursuit of other evil god armies, and the troops of the fastest races were already in sight.

When the number of Zerg puppies dropped to more than a thousand again, the cavalry of the evil god camp also suffered serious casualties, and the troops at this time were only more than ten thousand.

As expected, a large number of puppies rushed out from the rear of the Zerg army again!

Fortunately, the support troops of the evil god camp also arrived.

The cavalry of the evil god camp, which suffered heavy losses, began to retreat and rest, allowing the infantry that came to reinforce to fight with the Zerg puppies.

Zerg puppies are not rejected. These infantry of various races who have converted to the evil god are weaker and easier to kill!

The combination of Zerg puppies and hydralisks made the infantry of the evil god camp lose troops at a terrifying rate. Tens of thousands of infantry became sparse in the blink of an eye.

The cavalry of the evil god camp, which regrouped, wanted to bypass the flank of the battlefield and attack the rear of the Zerg army, but they were greeted by another black mass of Zerg puppies!
